parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- Desc: Descending order.

- Asc: Ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for the list of virtual resource groups. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of virtual resource groups to display on each page. The default value is 100.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The field that is used to sort the results. By default, the results are sorted by timestamp in descending order.

parameters.name: VirtualResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual resource group.

parameters.name: VirtualResourceName
parameters.description: The name of the virtual resource group.
